title: A Comprehensive Survey on Trustworthy Graph Neural Networks: Privacy, Robustness, Fairness, and Explainability
reasoning: The paper provides a comprehensive survey of trustworthy AI in the context of Graph Neural Networks, explicitly grounding its framework in the European Union's ethical principles: Respect for human autonomy, Prevention of harm, Fairness, and Explainability. It includes extensive sections on societal bias (Fairness) and interpretability (Explainability) as ethical requirements for trustworthy systems.
